tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Lists KEILTY Realty Management's property management services for rental owners in Ontario: what each includes, who it is for, its term, and the page that describes it.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns KEILTY's published fee schedule in Canadian dollars. Optionally filter to one service id from get_services.

service.description: Optional service id to filter to.

tools.name: get_service_areas
tools.description: Returns the Ontario communities KEILTY manages rental property in, its core Eastern Ontario markets, and markets it watches but does not serve yet.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Checks whether a rental property is a fit for KEILTY management. Returns fit (yes, nurture, waitlist or no), the reason, the recommended service and the next step. Call this before request_rental_evaluation.

city.description: Community the property is in, e.g. Kingston

owner_lives_there_now.description: True if the owner currently lives in the property

self_manage_after_lease.description: True if the owner only wants a resident placed and will manage the tenancy

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Returns verifiable facts about KEILTY: founding year, doors under management (about 1,200), location, markets, leadership, the response promise and where to read more.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Returns the link the owner can use to book a first call with A.J. Keilty, President. The owner picks the time themselves.

tools.name: request_rental_evaluation
tools.description: Submits a free rental evaluation request to KEILTY on the owner's behalf. KEILTY then contacts the owner directly. Only call this with the owner's explicit consent to share their contact details, and only once per property. The owner signs any agreement personally; this request commits them to nothing.

notes.description: Anything else the owner wants KEILTY to know

owner_consent.description: Must be true: the owner has agreed to share these details with KEILTY and to be contacted.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or app submitting, e.g. ChatGPT
